query.title: Company name contains
query.description: Free-text search matched against the registered company name. Leave blank to browse the directory using only the filters below (or with no filters at all, to list every company on file).

queries.title: Company name searches
queries.description: Multiple name searches to run in one job, each combined with the same island/year/city/sector/RCCM filters below. Combined with 'query' if both are set.

island.title: Island
island.description: Restrict results to one island. "Any" searches across all three.

year.title: Registration year
year.description: Filter by registration year on file (e.g. 2024). Leave blank for any year.

city.title: Headquarters / city contains
city.description: Free-text filter against the registered headquarters address/city (e.g. Moroni).

sector.title: Business sector
sector.description: Restrict results to one business sector. Note: as of this actor's last verification, ANPI's own directory has this field empty for every company on file, so any value other than "Any" currently returns zero results -- kept here in case ANPI populates this field later.

rccm.title: RCCM number
rccm.description: Filter by RCCM (Registre du Commerce et du Crédit Mobilier) number. Note: as of this actor's last verification, this field is empty for every company in ANPI's directory, so this filter currently returns zero results for any non-blank value -- kept here in case ANPI populates this field later.

maxResultsPerQuery.title: Max results per job
maxResultsPerQuery.description: Maximum number of company records to return per search/browse job.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrent workers
maxConcurrency.description: How many jobs/page-fetches may be in flight at once. The site's robots.txt sets Crawl-delay: 10, which this actor always honors for the actual outgoing request rate (max 1 request/10s) regardless of this setting -- this only bounds how much work is queued.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy configuration. Residential is on by default.
